passages.text: In the second year of the reign of Darius, on the first day of the sixth month, the word of the LORD came through Haggai the prophet to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, stating that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “These people say, ‘The time has not yet come to rebuild the house of the LORD.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Darius was king.
This was the second year of his reign.
It was the first day of the sixth month.
The LORD spoke.
The LORD spoke through Haggai.
Haggai was a prophet.
The LORD sent his word to Zerubbabel.
Zerubbabel was the son of Shealtiel.
Zerubbabel was governor of Judah.
The LORD also sent his word to Joshua.
Joshua was the son of Jehozadak.
Joshua was the high priest.
The LORD of Hosts said this:
“These people say,
‘The time has not yet come to rebuild the house of the LORD.’”
passages.original: בִּשְׁנַ֤ת שְׁתַּ֙יִם֙ לְדָרְיָ֣וֶשׁ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ בַּחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֨ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֜ה בְּיַד־ חַגַּ֣י הַנָּבִ֗יא אֶל־ זְרֻבָּבֶ֤ל בֶּן־ שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל֙ פַּחַ֣ת יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֧עַ בֶּן־ יְהוֹצָדָ֛ק הַכֹּהֵ֥ן הַגָּד֖וֹל לֵאמֹֽר׃ כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵאמֹ֑ר הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ אָֽמְר֔וּ לֹ֥א עֶת־ בֹּ֛א עֶת־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה לְהִבָּנֽוֹת׃פ

passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came through Haggai the prophet, saying: “Is it a time for you yourselves to live in your paneled houses, while this house lies in ruins?”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke through Haggai the prophet.
Haggai was a prophet of God.
God gave Haggai a message to deliver.
God asked the people a question.
God said, “Is this the right time for you to live in your paneled houses?”
God said, “My house is still in ruins.”
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה בְּיַד־ חַגַּ֥י הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹֽר׃ הַעֵ֤ת לָכֶם֙ אַתֶּ֔ם לָשֶׁ֖בֶת בְּבָתֵּיכֶ֣ם סְפוּנִ֑ים וְהַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּ֖ה חָרֵֽב׃

passages.text: Now this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Consider carefully your ways.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks now.
The LORD of Hosts commands you.
Pay close attention to your ways.
Think carefully about how you are living.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת שִׂ֥ימוּ לְבַבְכֶ֖ם עַל־ דַּרְכֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: You have planted much but harvested little. You eat but never have enough. You drink but never have your fill. You put on clothes but never get warm. You earn wages to put into a bag pierced through.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts spoke through Haggai the prophet.
He spoke to the people of Israel.
You have planted many seeds.
You have gathered only a small harvest.
You eat food.
You do not become full.
You drink.
You do not feel satisfied.
You put on clothes.
You do not feel warm.
You earn money.
You put your money into a bag with holes.
Your money does not last.
passages.original: זְרַעְתֶּ֨ם הַרְבֵּ֜ה וְהָבֵ֣א מְעָ֗ט אָכ֤וֹל וְאֵין־ לְשָׂבְעָה֙ שָׁת֣וֹ וְאֵין־ לְשָׁכְרָ֔ה לָב֖וֹשׁ וְאֵין־ לְחֹ֣ם ל֑וֹ וְהַ֨מִּשְׂתַּכֵּ֔ר מִשְׂתַּכֵּ֖ר אֶל־ צְר֥וֹר נָקֽוּב׃פ

passages.text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Consider carefully your ways.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He is powerful over all armies.
He says, “Think about your actions.
Pay close attention to the way you live.”
passages.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת שִׂ֥ימוּ לְבַבְכֶ֖ם עַל־ דַּרְכֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Go up into the hills, bring down lumber, and build the house, so that I may take pleasure in it and be glorified, says the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He commands the people.
Go up into the hills.
Bring down wood.
Build the house for the LORD.
Then I will take pleasure in it.
Then I will be honored.
passages.original: עֲל֥וּ הָהָ֛ר וַהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם עֵ֖ץ וּבְנ֣וּ הַבָּ֑יִת וְאֶרְצֶה־ בּ֥וֹ וְאֶכָּבֵד אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: You expected much, but behold, it amounted to little. And what you brought home, I blew away. Why? declares the LORD of Hosts. Because My house still lies in ruins, while each of you is busy with his own house.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
You expected much.
You received little.
You brought things home.
I blew them away.
Why did I do this?
My house still lies in ruins.
Each of you runs to your own house.
You care for your own house.
You neglect My house.
passages.original: פָּנֹ֤ה אֶל־ הַרְבֵּה֙ וְהִנֵּ֣ה לִמְעָ֔ט וַהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם הַבַּ֖יִת וְנָפַ֣חְתִּי ב֑וֹ יַ֣עַן מֶ֗ה נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת יַ֗עַן בֵּיתִי֙ אֲשֶׁר־ ה֣וּא חָרֵ֔ב וְאַתֶּ֥ם רָצִ֖ים אִ֥ישׁ לְבֵיתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Therefore, on account of you the heavens have withheld their dew and the earth has withheld its crops.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God says the people have neglected His house.
Because of this, God acts.
The heavens do not give dew.
The earth does not give crops.
God withholds blessing because of the people's actions.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּ֣ן עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם כָּלְא֥וּ שָמַ֖יִם מִטָּ֑ל וְהָאָ֖רֶץ כָּלְאָ֥ה יְבוּלָֽהּ׃

passages.text: I have summoned a drought on the fields and on the mountains, on the grain, new wine, and oil, and on whatever the ground yields, on man and beast, and on all the labor of your hands.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking.
The LORD has power over nature and people.
The LORD summoned a drought.
The drought came on the fields.
The drought came on the mountains.
The drought came on the grain.
The drought came on the new wine.
The drought came on the oil.
The drought came on everything the ground produces.
The drought came on people.
The drought came on animals.
The drought came on all the work of your hands.
passages.original: וָאֶקְרָ֨א חֹ֜רֶב עַל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ וְעַל־ הֶהָרִ֗ים וְעַל־ הַדָּגָן֙ וְעַל־ הַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְעַל־ הַיִּצְהָ֔ר וְעַ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תּוֹצִ֖יא הָאֲדָמָ֑ה וְעַל־ הָֽאָדָם֙ וְעַל־ הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ יְגִ֥יעַ כַּפָּֽיִם׃ס

passages.text: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, as well as all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the LORD their God and the words of the prophet Haggai, because the LORD their God had sent him. So the people feared the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Zerubbabel was the son of Shealtiel.
Joshua was the son of Jehozadak.
Joshua was the high priest.
A remnant of the people remained in Judah.
Zerubbabel, Joshua, and all the remnant of the people heard the voice of the LORD their God.
They listened to the words of Haggai the prophet.
The LORD their God had sent Haggai to them.
The people feared the LORD.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע זְרֻבָּבֶ֣ל׀ בֶּֽן־ שַׁלְתִּיאֵ֡ל וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בֶּן־ יְהוֹצָדָק֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן הַגָּד֜וֹל וְכֹ֣ל׀ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית הָעָ֗ם בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֔ם וְעַל־ דִּבְרֵי֙ חַגַּ֣י הַנָּבִ֔יא כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁלָח֖וֹ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּֽירְא֥וּ הָעָ֖ם מִפְּנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Haggai, the messenger of the LORD, delivered the message of the LORD to the people: “I am with you,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Haggai was a prophet.
Haggai served as the messenger of the LORD.
Haggai spoke to the people for the LORD.
Haggai gave the people a message from the LORD.
The LORD said, “I am with you.”
passages.original: וַ֠יֹּאמֶר חַגַּ֞י מַלְאַ֧ךְ יְהוָ֛ה בְּמַלְאֲכ֥וּת יְהוָ֖ה לָעָ֣ם לֵאמֹ֑ר אֲנִ֥י אִתְּכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: So the LORD stirred the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, as well as the spirit of all the remnant of the people. And they came and began the work on the house of the LORD of Hosts, their God, on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month, in the second year of King Darius.
passages.sermon:
The LORD acted.
The LORD stirred the spirit of Zerubbabel.
Zerubbabel was the son of Shealtiel.
Zerubbabel was the governor of Judah.
The LORD stirred the spirit of Joshua.
Joshua was the son of Jehozadak.
Joshua was the high priest.
The LORD stirred the spirit of all the remnant of the people.
The people responded.
They came together.
They began the work.
They worked on the house of the LORD of Hosts.
The LORD of Hosts was their God.
They started this work on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month.
This happened in the second year of King Darius.
passages.original: וַיָּ֣עַר יְהוָ֡ה אֶת־ רוּחַ֩ זְרֻבָּבֶ֨ל בֶּן־ שַׁלְתִּיאֵ֜ל פַּחַ֣ת יְהוּדָ֗ה וְאֶת־ ר֙וּחַ֙ יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בֶּן־ יְהוֹצָדָק֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֔וֹל וְֽאֶת־ ר֔וּחַ כֹּ֖ל שְׁאֵרִ֣ית הָעָ֑ם וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ וַיַּעֲשׂ֣וּ מְלָאכָ֔ה בְּבֵית־ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃פ בְּי֨וֹם עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֛ה לַחֹ֖דֶשׁ בַּשִּׁשִּׁ֑י בִּשְׁנַ֥ת שְׁתַּ֖יִם לְדָרְיָ֥וֶשׁ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
